notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 2026 call sheet lists Bravo! Vail Music Festival, 970-827-5700, and a separate note says info@bravovail.org, attn Wes. Adventure Zone also emailed the festival in April 2026. Source: handwritten call notes, pages 112/113; Adventure Zone Gmail.
